---
title: "Blog"
subtitle: "Latest news and updates"
listing:
  contents: "*/index.qmd"
  type: default
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: true
  sort-ui: true
  filter-ui: true
  fields: [image, title, description, date, reading-time, categories]
  feed: true
page-layout: full
include-after-body:
  text: |
    <script>
    document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-post").forEach(function (post) {
      var title = post.querySelector(".listing-title");
      var meta = post.querySelector(".metadata");
      if (title && meta) title.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", meta);
    });
    </script>
---
